description: Builds a DMARC TXT record for _dmarc.<domain>: policy, subdomain policy, percentage, report addresses and SPF and DKIM alignment. Returns the record and findings about reporting and policy strength.

dkim_alignment.description: r for relaxed (default) or s for strict.

domain.description: The domain the record is for, such as example.com. Optional.

failure_options.description: The fo tag values: 0, 1, d or s.

percent.description: Share of mail the policy applies to. Defaults to 100.

policy.description: The p tag. Defaults to none.

spf_alignment.description: r for relaxed (default) or s for strict.

subdomain_policy.description: The sp tag. Defaults to the same as policy.

name: dmarc_record_generator
title: DMARC record generator
